title: Bridge two surfaces
summary: Fill a gap between two compatible world surfaces with editable terrain.
outcome: A solid, editable terrain bridge spans the selected boundaries while source surfaces remain intact.

sections.title: Connect the surfaces

steps.title: Select two surfaces in order
steps.text: Choose Create > Bridge between surfaces…. Select the start and end world surfaces: curved patches, terrain, or brushes. A whole brush uses its top face; Face mode lets you choose another face.

steps.title: Set the shape
steps.text: Review the suggested nearest compatible boundaries and change either if needed. Set Rows across the gap and Center rise; positive rise makes a hump and negative rise a dip.

steps.title: Create and inspect
steps.text: Click Create bridge. The source surfaces remain and one new solid terrain surface spans them. Check its boundary alignment and Undo if it bridges the wrong edges.

tips: If Create bridge is unavailable, reselect two supported world surfaces in order and choose compatible boundaries.
